subject: Archaeology
title: Neanderthal DNA in Modern Humans
description: Learn Neanderthal DNA in Modern Humans in one minute.

hook.text: If you have European or Asian ancestry, about two percent of your DNA is Neanderthal.

buildup.text: Svante Pääbo sequenced the Neanderthal genome in 2010, proving interbreeding with humans.

discovery.text: Neanderthal DNA influences skin color, immune response, and sleep patterns today.

twist.text: Some inherited genes helped survival. Others are linked to autoimmune diseases.

climax.text: Pääbo won the 2022 Nobel Prize for founding paleogenomics — reading DNA of the dead.

punchline.text: Neanderthals vanished 40,000 years ago. Their DNA still shapes your body.

quiz.question: What did Svante Pääbo's Nobel-winning work reveal?
options: Neanderthals were a subspecies of humans, not separate
People of European and Asian descent carry about 2% Neanderthal DNA
Neanderthals went extinct due to a single global pandemic
